verdict.rationale: 1Password documents machine-oriented, non-interactive access built for automation. The Credential Broker gives CI/CD and other machine workflows short-lived access to secrets, Service Accounts automate secrets management, and Connect Servers expose a private REST API for apps and infrastructure. The scriptable op CLI underpins these surfaces. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of the CLI authenticating headlessly in a CI runner (the CLI docs shown emphasize Touch ID or Windows Hello sign-in), and independent or hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation

citations.quote: Use the 1Password Credential Broker to give CI/CD and other machine workflows short-lived access to secrets, without managing service account tokens.
1Password Service Accounts help automate secrets management in your applications and infrastructure without the need to deploy additional services.
1Password Connect Servers allow you to securely access your 1Password items and vaults in your company's apps and cloud infrastructure using a private REST API.
the scriptable surface behind service accounts, Connect, and secrets automation
